name: ddosify
description: High-performance load testing tool, written in Golang

options.name: -l
options.description: Type of the request. Default: linear

options.name: -h
options.description: Headers of the request. You can provide multiple headers

options.name: -o
options.description: Test result output format. Default: stdout

options.name: --config
options.description: Config file of the load test i.e example_ddosify_config.json

options.name: --version
options.description: Prints version, git commit, built date (utc)

options.name: --debug
options.description: Iterates the scenario once and prints curl-like verbose result
